steps.text: Talk to Sylas by the POH portal in Taverley.
Talk to Grimgnash the griffin on the NE side of White Wolf Mountain (see map).
chat: 1. I heard you were a great and mighty Griffin!
1. There once was a graveyard filled with undead.
2. There lived a skeleton named Skullrot.
4. Skullrot hungrily grabbed the gnome's hair.
3. Started to strangle the poor gnome.
1. He saw a hole he could just fit through.

steps.text: Steal a feather from next to his nest.
Return to Sylas and give him the feather.
chat: 3. I should be off, I think.

steps.text: Go to the stone tower south of the Mind Altar.
Climb over the crumbling wall on the East side (58 Thieving)
Talk-into to the drain pipe. Then talk into it again
chat: 2. I think I might have an idea!
2. I could try and climb up.
2. Is there anything up there that can help?

steps.text: Climb the beard and talk to Rupert the Beard. (59 Agility)
Climb down the beard and talk to Miazrqa behind the tower.
chat: 2. I see there is an embarrassed-looking dwarf...
4. I need a key for the house.
4. I should be off, I think.

sections.title: Miazrqa's pendant
notes: Needed: Leather gloves (optional, to avoid an electric shock from the gate), 2 tarromin potions (unf), door key from witch's house, 3 free inventory spaces
Note: Ensure that your pet is banked or in your inventory as it will prevent you from drinking the shrinking potion
Note: Level 95 mice will attack you while in this area, hitting up to 9 damage. Protect from Melee prayer is advised if in low armour gear.
Warning: Do not exit the area with the level 95 mice until you've collected the pendant.

steps.text: Enter the basement of the witch's house next to the POH portal in Taverley.
Go to the piano on the southern wall, play the notes E-F-E-D-C on the right side (upper), then A-E-G-A on the left side (lower).
Search the piano.
Add the Shrunk ogleroot to your unfinished potions (52 Herblore).
Go through the south door on and drink a shrinking potion by the mouse hole.
Climb up the nails to the north-east.
Climb up the nails to the south-west.
Climb up the nails to the south.
Climb down the nails to the north-east.
Climb up the nails to the north-east.
Take the pendant.
Travel back to the tower and give the pendant to Miazrqa.
Talk to Rupert.
Optional: You can talk to Miazrqa and Rupert again to unlock extra humorous dialogue.

sections.title: The beanstalk
notes: Needed: Combat equipment, any woodcutting axe, a seed dibber, a watering can, Rupert's helmet and a shrink potion.

steps.text: Give Rupert's helmet to Sylas.
Plant and water the beans in the plot south-west of the Taverley tree patch (45 Farming).
Climb up the beanstalk (59 Agility). You cannot climb with a follower/pet, even if it's in your inventory.
Defeat Glod and pick up the golden goblin.
Talk to Sylas.
Use a shrinking potion on the beanstalk then chop it down (71 Woodcutting). Be careful not to drink it!
If you're stat-boosting make sure you use the shrinking potion before you stat boost - an animation plays and this could cause your stat boost to expire
Talk to Sylas.
Congratulations, quest complete!
